metadata.target_role: Product Manager, Global Learning & Knowledge Platforms

profile_summary: Product leader with 10+ years of experience building digital learning ecosystems, content-led platforms, internal tracking tools, and AI-enabled agentic workflows across Byju’s, Tynker, WhiteHat Jr., Programming Hub, and Lowe’s India. Proven track record in product strategy, roadmap ownership, UX optimization, prototyping, and cross-functional alignment across engineering, content, design, and leadership teams. Skilled in translating user needs into scalable solutions using KPI frameworks and internal analytics, delivering 500+ hours of learning content, 80%+ completion rates, 15% lower instructor training time, 35% higher conversion, and 20% faster AI-driven catalog cycle times.

sub_bullets: Owned enterprise platform reliability initiatives across engineering and operations teams by establishing scalable workflow automation and SLA governance, maintaining 99.99% reliability
Designed KPI frameworks and dashboards using internal enterprise analytics tools to track adoption, workflow efficiency, and incident resolution to guide roadmap prioritization
Translated organizational goals into annual and quarterly product roadmaps by aligning engineering and business stakeholders around performance data, targeting 20% incident volume reduction
Led revenue protection initiatives by deploying automated recovery agents and incident-handling workflows to remove process friction, cutting order cancellations and saving ~$10M annually
Facilitated technical and non-technical stakeholder alignment across product, engineering, finance, and operations through structured business reviews and KPI governance
Diagnosed operational pain points across planning and lifecycle programs with operations, IT, and business teams to prioritize integrated workflow improvements
Spearheaded a unified enterprise asset lifecycle platform with finance, operations, and infrastructure stakeholders to streamline workflows and visibility, delivering $2M in annual savings
Designed and launched an AI-driven procurement and catalog platform powered by agentic workflows to streamline user adoption and task orchestration, reducing cycle times by 20%
